name: Penetrating Fear [Psionic]
body:
Your terrors are able to affect those normally immune.

Prerequisite: Terrors class feature, 10th level dread

Benefit: You can expend your psionic focus when activating a terror to allow it to affect those normally immune to fear effects or mind-affecting effects. The target gets a +4 bonus to any applicable save against the effect.
